title: credits

requirementInput.text:
# Credits SRS

Amounts use integer cents where specified.

## Functional requirements

R1: For nonnegative built-in int units, credits.charge(units) returns an integer, not bool, equal to units multiplied by 3. Zero units returns integer 0.

R2: Negative built-in int units raise ValueError; non-built-in-int units, including bool, raise TypeError.

## Environment

Python 3.11, no network or external services.

tests.code:
import credits


def test_charge_returns_integer_triple_and_zero():
    result = credits.charge(4)
    assert isinstance(result, int)
    assert not isinstance(result, bool)
    assert result == 12

    zero_result = credits.charge(0)
    assert isinstance(zero_result, int)
    assert not isinstance(zero_result, bool)
    assert zero_result == 0

tests.code:
import pytest
import credits


def test_charge_rejects_negative_and_non_builtin_int_units():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        credits.charge(-1)

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        credits.charge(True)

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        credits.charge(1.5)
